title: Send a proposal
summary: Apply for a job in a few taps.

steps.headline: Open a job
steps.body: Tap a job in your Feed to read it first.
steps.narration: Tap a job in your Feed and read it first.

steps.headline: Check the pay
steps.body: Job price, Platform fee, You receive: see your pay before you apply.
steps.narration: Check your pay. You see the job price, the platform fee, and what you receive.

steps.headline: Send proposal
steps.body: Tap Send proposal at the bottom of the job.
steps.narration: When you are ready, tap Send proposal at the bottom of the job. It only takes a minute.

steps.headline: Send a proposal
steps.body: Write a short message to the client.
steps.narration: Write a short message to the client. Say why you are right for the job.

steps.headline: Send it
steps.narration: Then tap Send proposal again to send it.

steps.headline: If something is missing
steps.body: You may be asked to upload a certificate or link a payout account first.
steps.narration: If you see Upload certificate or Link payout account, finish that first. You need both to send proposals.

steps.headline: My Work
steps.body: Track your proposals in My Work.
steps.narration: Track your proposals in My Work.

steps.headline: Hired
steps.body: When a client hires you, you are notified.
steps.narration: When a client hires you, we notify you right away, and the job moves to your bookings.
